name: C.H. Robinson

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (C. H. Robinson logo.svg)

description: C.H. Robinson is a freight middleman. About 75,000 customers give it freight and it moves it using a network of about 450,000 contract carriers (motor carriers, railroads, ocean and air lines), matched through its Navisphere software. It books the whole freight charge as revenue ($16.2B in 2025) and pays most of it out as purchased transportation ($12.2B); what it keeps is adjusted gross profit ($2.73B, 16.8 percent of revenue). Because revenue swings with freight prices while the spread pays for the staff, the company reports operating income against adjusted gross profit (29 percent in 2025, computed). It also sells fresh produce (Robinson Fresh) and managed logistics services. It sold its Europe road business in February 2025 and cut headcount while operating income rose 18.8 percent.

gics.note: The Wikipedia list gives only GICS sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry are not in that source and are left null, not filled from memory. SEC SIC code from the EDGAR submissions record: 4731 Arrangement of Transportation of Freight & Cargo.

hq.note: 14701 Charlson Road, Eden Prairie, MN 55347 (FY2025 10-K); reincorporated in Delaware in 1997 as successor to a business in existence in various legal forms since 1905

employees.note: 11,855 employees plus 761 contingent workers; 9,899 network employees (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: North American Surface Transportation (NAST) (reportable segment)
businessLines.how: Shippers pay C.H. Robinson a price per load or shipment and it pays a contracted motor carrier for the same load; the spread is the profit, driven by volume, freight-market pricing and how well it buys capacity.
businessLines.description: Truckload and less-than-truckload (LTL) freight brokerage (10-K describes Truckload and LTL service lines; NAST covers North America).

businessLines.name: Global Forwarding (reportable segment)
businessLines.how: Importers and exporters pay a price per shipment; it buys space from ocean and air carriers and keeps the difference, plus customs brokerage fees. Profit per shipment swung with ocean rates in 2025.
businessLines.description: Ocean, air and customs services worldwide (licensed NVOCC, indirect air carrier and customs broker).

businessLines.name: All Other and Corporate (segment group)
businessLines.how: Robinson Fresh buys produce and sells it to retail and foodservice customers; Managed Solutions charges for logistics management, consulting and TMS technology.
businessLines.description: Robinson Fresh (produce sourcing), Managed Solutions (4PL, managed transportation and TMS technology, launched Nov 2024), Other Surface Transportation (Europe road business, sold Feb 2025) and unallocated corporate.

businessLines.name: Truckload (service line inside NAST)
businessLines.how: Spread between the price charged to the shipper and the carrier cost per load; volume +0.5% in 2025 (10-K).

businessLines.name: LTL (service line inside NAST)
businessLines.how: Consolidates single-pallet and partial shipments; earns the spread per shipment; volume +1.5% in 2025 (10-K).

businessLines.name: Ocean (service line inside Global Forwarding)
businessLines.how: NVOCC and forwarder spread between what customers pay and ocean carrier cost; volume -4.5% in 2025 (10-K).

businessLines.name: Air (service line inside Global Forwarding)
businessLines.how: Indirect air carrier spread between customer price and air carrier cost; volume -11.5% in 2025 (10-K).

businessLines.name: Customs (service line inside Global Forwarding)
businessLines.how: Fees as a licensed customs broker; volume +1.0% in 2025 (10-K).

businessLines.name: Robinson Fresh (service line inside All Other)
businessLines.how: Sourcing and selling fresh produce (Sourcing revenue $1,409.0M in 2025) plus integrated supply chain services.

businessLines.name: Managed Solutions (service line inside All Other)
businessLines.how: Fees for 4PL, managed transportation and TMS technology; launched November 2024 (10-K).

brands.name: Navisphere
brands.note: Proprietary transportation management platform used to match customers and carriers

brands.name: Robinson Fresh
brands.note: Produce sourcing; Sourcing revenue $1,408.96M in FY2025 (8.7% of revenue, computed) vs $1,371.2M in FY2024

brands.name: C.H. Robinson Managed Solutions
brands.note: Launched November 2024; absorbs the former TMC division
